Subject: Post-call recap & next steps - Redwood x Acme (quick)

Thanks again for taking the time this morning, Jordan - really helpful to understand Acme's priorities. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps: 

Summary of needs:
- Primary use: reduce inference cost on internal customer-facing assistant + batch reranking for search
- Expected scale: ~200M tokens/month in year 1, peak bursts up to 1.5k qps for chat flows
- Success metrics: median p95 latency <200ms, per-token cost target <$0.002 (total infra + ops)
- Security constraints: SOC2 required, data residency in us-east preferred

Key open / asks for Acme:
1) Confirm economic buyer and budget owner so we can loop them in for pricing and procurement
2) Procurement/security steps (questionnaire, SOW/contract owner)
3) Quick technical follow-up on model variants/latency targets (Alex is copied)

Proposed next steps:
- Jordan to confirm who the economic buyer & budget owner are (if you can intro, that would be great)
- I'll send a short pricing + MAP doc and propose a 30-min intro with the budget owner to discuss procurement timeline

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Acme_v1.pdf, pricing_1pager.pdf (see attached)

If you can intro to the right person this week, we'll share a short proposal and procurement checklist.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
